title: Carve 0.2 include directive options
description: The six option keys of an include directive (C2-B-204, C2-B-205), in the order the writer and the tree list them (C2-W-058, C2-A-181). Every other key makes the line a paragraph. `options` is sorted by `rank`.

rank.description: The place of the option in the written and the tree order.

kind.description: selection: chooses the included content. transform: reshapes the selected content. mode: decides what the content becomes. The expansion reads the kind; the parser does not.

value.description: The shape of the value (C2-B-205). range: `N-M`, decimal, no leading zero, N at least 1 and at most M. identifier: an ASCII letter or `_`, then ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `-`. range_or_names: a range, or a quoted list of column names. signed_integer_or_auto: an optional `+` or `-` and decimal digits, or `auto`. language: ASCII letters, digits and `-`, `_`, `+`, `#`, `.`, `/`.

without_value.description: What the key written with no colon gives. paragraph: the line is no include directive. include_node: the line is an include node, and an expansion reports the option. valid: the bare key is a well-formed option.

outside_shape.description: What a value outside the shape gives, an empty value after the colon included.

repeated.description: What a second option with the same key gives.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.
